answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own cipher record, and its own share of the lantern quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 3 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. The vertex ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 4293 identities would post 1936 proofs and burn roughly 13 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
